subject: op-spd
title: (R)OP.SPD.------VT.PLT.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-6 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the next cycle in western culture promises to be very … interesting' — interesting because the late-seventies sentiment (that injustices have been corrected) sets up a particular vibrational position for what follows. (R)OP-SPD (the reality of option-spread) is crossed with VT-PLT (vibrational platform): the question is what option-spread produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with vibrational-platform — the (R) prefix marking Braxton's commitment that option-spread is what actually obtains for late-seventies America. ALT-ACT (alternative activism) feeds in from the upper-left. DYM-SPT (dynamics-spectacle) sits centrally between subject and partner. VT-PLT is the partner. AFI (affinity insight) anchors the upper-right output. RT-DY (reality dynamics) sits below the crossing. EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) anchors the lower-center. WO-EXP-PRI (world experiential principles) hangs on the lower-right margin. Structural argument: option-spread-as-real crossed with vibrational-platform is mediated by dynamics-spectacle as central hub — exposing Braxton's structural diagnostic that the late-seventies' option-spread is *spectacle-mediated*, not vibrational-platform-mediated. The schematic is the case for why the 'interesting' next cycle will replicate spectacle: alternative-activism remains as upper upstream feeding into the dynamics-spectacle hub, and the productive output (affinity-insight) is downstream of spectacle. World-experiential-principles as the lower-right margin is what would normally provide the *real* upstream — its marginal position registers its absence from the operative configuration.
